definitions.gloss: kabosu; a green Japanese citrus fruit used as a condiment
definitions.explanation: A round, green citrus fruit about the size of a golf ball, primarily grown in Oita Prefecture. Used for its tart juice as a seasoning squeezed over fish, hot pot dishes, and other foods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かぼす⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{搾|しぼ}る→搾る：18724_shiboru⟧。
examples.english: To squeeze kabosu over grilled fish.

examples.japanese: かぼす⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{果汁|かじゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦さっぱりして→さっぱりする：26802_sapparisuru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Kabosu juice is refreshingly tart and delicious.

examples.japanese: {大分県|おおいたけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧かぼす⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生産量|せいさんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{日本一|にほんいち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特産品|とくさんひん}→特産品：13483_tokusanhin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Oita Prefecture has the highest kabosu production in Japan, and it is known as a local specialty.

notes:
Written in kanji as {臭橙|かぼす} or {香母酢|かぼす}, but hiragana or katakana (カボス) is standard. The name may derive from the strong fragrance ({香|か}) of the fruit. Over 95% of Japan's kabosu comes from {大分県|おおいたけん}.

USAGE:
Kabosu is used similarly to lemon or lime in Western cooking — squeezed over dishes as a finishing touch. It is a key ingredient in ponzu and is especially popular with grilled fish, ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (hot pot), and ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- かぼす⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{搾|しぼ}る→搾る：18724_shiboru⟧ — to squeeze kabosu
- かぼす⟦{果汁|かじゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧ — kabosu juice
- かぼす⟦ポン{酢|ず}→ポン酢：11115_ponzu⟧ — kabosu ponzu
- かぼすサワー — kabosu sour (cocktail)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すだち→すだち：21815_sudachi⟧ — sudachi (smaller, from Tokushima; similar use but more aromatic)
- ゆず — yuzu (more fragrant, used for both juice and zest; wider culinary range)
- ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧ — lemon (Western citrus; more sour, less nuanced aroma)
